review_notes.evidence: All 19 G3 portions listed above print 3396 in the native RY071 gate blocks. The A1 RY071 list records 3596 at the same board/socket/portion for each. The 26 other portions agree.

Enlarged original-source crop shows 3308E1 N block at printed grid 4M, with B07 input and D06 output. A diamond at B07 branches the 3M B04 signal to the -IND ROS BIT 20 FQ PARITY edge. The D06 output crosses that rail without a diamond, then joins the lower +ROS REG BIT 20 rail at its printed diamond. Normal 4M lattice position retained.

Native print starts with a short downward hook immediately left of the 7-bank output vertical; no diamond joins the crossing. The visible source is an open hook, so the rail is retained as a separate printed continuation with unresolved electrical origin.

Intervening horizontal rails show plain crossings. The printed output is retained as an additional driver of that rail.

TIFF x5800-7100 y2970-3900 plus x7400-9200 y2820-3250: the native output-to-next-OR diamond rises to a separate horizontal stub which turns upward at the right into -ROS REG BIT 18 without a terminal diamond. Native print places RY011 just below the -ROS REG BIT 18 label, while the preceding -ROS DATA LTH BIT 19 continuation has DR201 beneath it. The 245×103 grid places RY011 between those two rows to preserve the continuous -REG18 wire tail.

The first table entry visibly resembles FF041BA4 while the main left-edge bit-17 source reference reads EF041BA4. The table print is retained literally as FF041BA4 pending independent enlarged-source review.
